what: Photo inside a rounded blob frame — while scrolling down the stretched hero track, the frame’s mask size grows from 91.59% to 200% so the photo spills out of the frame and covers the screen, and the photo shrinks from 1.2x to 1x (tied to scroll, no curve)

duration.Scroll: From when the track’s top edge touches the top of the screen until its bottom edge touches the bottom of the screen

options.from: Initial mask size (%), default 91.59 — also match --fx-from in css
options.scale: Photo start scale, default 1.2 — at 1 it doesn’t shrink
options.lag: Seconds to lag behind scroll (scrub value), default 0 (immediate) — Brand 1.5

note: The track (the pinned element) must be taller than the screen for a range to exist. The original pins a 200vh panel with position: fixed behind the screen and lifts the next section above it with margin-top: 200vh

from.where: product.html .nk-activity-kv (200vh pinned panel) .cover — built in product.js with the same values (91.59→200%, 1.2→1), and the text inside the panel moves up a quarter of the screen with sine.in while the next section rises

index.html .w-video__mask (house-shaped mask video) — original c-video-house: --mask-scale .08→1.5 applied as mask-size calc(×300%), start top 50% (top 100% on phone), end bottom top, scrub 1.5, ease none
from.options: from: 24; to: 450; scale: 1; start: top 50%; end: bottom top; lag: 1.5 — house silhouette in --fx-mask, --fx-from: 24%

from.where: index.html .hm-exp (experience section, screen pinned +150vh) .hm-exp__mv — original p-top-experience__mv: maskSize 100%→1000%(top top → bottom+=50% top, pin, scrub), the inner photo scale .58→1 over the first 10vh (bottom-=Ends within 90% top). When fully open (35vh), left shade 1s + title and text .5s bounce back
from.options: from: 100; to: 1000; scale: .58; start: top top; end: bottom+=50% top — --fx-mask is a vertical center pill (a 307×460 rounded rectangle on a 1300×770 panel), --fx-from: 100%. Unlike the original, where the photo scale finishes before the mask, the parts shrink over the same range
